description: LIMA AI is the NVDA add-on companion to the LIMA (Low-Vision Intelligent Machine Assistant) desktop app. Press a shortcut and NVDA speaks a brief AI description of the active screen or of the control you are focused on, click any on-screen control just by describing it, toggle live narration of changes on a web page, and check how much of your monthly credit you have used. Replies can be in English, Tagalog, or Vietnamese.
changelog: New: press NVDA+Alt+U to hear how much of your monthly LIMA credit you have used and when it resets.
